title: Threat Intelligence IOC Batch v1
description: Schema for a batch of IOC records loaded into the threat intelligence store. All inserts are idempotent. Batch loading is replay-safe — replaying the same batch produces the same store state.

batch_id.description: Unique batch identifier. Used for replay tracking — replaying the same batch_id is safe.

source.description: Feed name or analyst source that produced this batch.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this batch was generated by the source.

iocs.description: Array of IOC records. Each IOC is idempotent by ioc_id.

ttl_seconds_default.description: Default TTL applied to IOCs in this batch that do not specify their own ttl_seconds.

metadata.description: Optional feed metadata (feed version, classification, TLP level, etc.).
